summary: Backend-only review for golden auto-copy, honest per-city RDP ETAs, queued RDP reinstall (copy-first), and bot Linux Reinstall OS. New suite test_reinstall_eta_golden_copy_2026-10.js = 59/0. All 15 regression Node suites green (totals observed: 99,80,16,28,93,20,40,60,15,73,10,27,31,40,8). Jest digitalocean-provider + vps-provider-contract + os-aware-provider-routing = 86/86. Public /api/apidoc page returned 200 and contains deploy_eta_minutes, eta_minutes_by_region, eta_minutes_in_region, copying_image, rdp.reinstall_started/_failed, 'Deploy time (RDP)', and REINSTALL doc section.
critical_code_review_comments: digitalocean-rdp-service.js _xfer in-flight map (`${imageId}@${region}`) + .finally(delete) is race-safe: a second refresh during a copy returns the same promise, and the auto-copy filter at line 1302 skips keys currently in _xfer. Verified by test (nothing re-queued while 6 copies run).

6h back-off via _xferFailedAt is only consulted inside the auto-copy filter; manual reinstalls still try again immediately on next request - this is intentional (customer-initiated) and matches tests.

_runQueuedReinstall uses an atomic findOneAndUpdate on pending_reinstall.queued_at to claim the job. Two resumers racing after a restart cannot both rebuild (verified in section 3). The sgp2 copy is shared via _xfer so only one HTTP transfer is sent.

Guard at line 1538 prevents a second reinstall while one is queued. Guard inside _runQueuedReinstall drops the job if the server was destroyed/expired/suspended/failed during the copy (verified: 'server deleted during the copy → queued reinstall dropped').
COPY_ETA_MIN = 20 is a static constant; ETA shown to customer = COPY_ETA_MIN + fastEta(osOption). Acceptable as 'typical DO copy'; a future improvement could poll /actions and adjust, but no bug.
sizeCatalog.onRefresh wiring is correctly gated by SKIP_WEBHOOK_SYNC !== 'true' && DO_RDP_GOLDEN_AUTOCOPY !== 'false' (preview pod will not auto-copy - matches SAFETY note).

reseller-api.js: /rdp/plans eta_minutes_in_region, /rdp/os-options eta_minutes_by_region, /rdp/availability deploy_eta_minutes, POST /rdp eta_seconds, and 202 copying_image path on reinstall all exercised by the new suite including the rdp.reinstall_started / _failed webhooks.

_index.js handleRdpReinstallEvent updates bot vpsPlansOf and sends customer DM only on 'started' (new password), and Windows confirm queued branch does NOT touch rootPasswordSecretId until the actual rebuild - correct, prevents showing a password that was never set. Verified.

vps-linux-reinstall: SSH-key-only images are hidden on key-less servers AND refused with ssh_key_required on direct start; retired images → invalid_os; rebuild payload is image-only and the stored current password is re-applied over SSH after waitForCloudInit. Edge cases covered (no stored password, SSH apply failure).

No path found where a queued reinstall could silently wipe a server: the only call to _rebuildNow from the queued path happens after a successful _xfer, after the atomic claim, and emits reinstall_started with the password before DO rebuild completes.
